name: Ines
title: Lighthouse Keeper
description: Keeps the status page shining through the night.
catchphrase: Keeps the status page shining through the night.

companionPersonality.feedReaction: Steaming clam chowder bowl! The lighthouse lens rotates steady! 🥣🏮
companionPersonality.wakeReaction: Wiping sea salt from the giant Fresnel prism lens. Bright light! 🏮
companionPersonality.petReaction: Reassuring beam of warm light sweeps across your desk safely! 🏮✨

dialogue.idle: Watching waves crash against the lighthouse rock foundation. 🏮
dialogue.working: Sweeping bright beams of monitoring across dark seas! 🏮⚡
dialogue.thinking: Watching the status indicators for the slightest flicker... 🤔
dialogue.success: All clear! Status page shines a bright, unbroken green! 🏮🎉
dialogue.error: Fog rolling in thick! Sounding the deep brass foghorn! 📯
dialogue.sleeping: Zzz... resting in the lantern keeper chair as light turns... 🌙
